subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: When a process record is written, the system shall reconcile it against that harness's required-figure set and record a discrepancy for every required figure that is neither measured nor declared unavailable.
rationale: a figure that is silently omitted emits nothing, so a metric fed only by successful unavailability declarations cannot observe the omission it exists to detect — the reconciliation is what makes M2 falsifiable, exactly as FR-13 makes M1 falsifiable
fit_criterion: seeding a record whose writer drops a required figure without declaring it yields a recorded discrepancy naming the process and the figure; a record with every required figure resolved yields none
